uniqueAngle.existingConsensus: New-rep ramp is a content problem: more enablement, more certification.
uniqueAngle.keelClaim: Ramp is a judgment-acquisition problem — new reps need reps, at-bats with debriefs, not another course.
uniqueAngle.supportingReason: Pattern recognition builds from processed experience; content without reflection produces confident recital, not judgment.
